page: Microsoft Azure FX36mds is a memory-intensive virtual machine belonging to the FXMDVS server family. Powered by an Intel processor with an x86_64 architecture, this instance features 36 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is equipped with 756.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 21.0 GB per vCPU.

For local storage needs, the FX36mds includes a bundled 1548 GB local solid-state drive (SSD). The instance is also designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or onboard GPU hardware.

Due to its high memory density relative to compute cores, this server type is designed for memory-bound workloads. The qualitative cost efficiency of this hardware profile is optimized for resource-heavy applications that require large in-memory datasets rather than raw computational scaling. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and heavy caching layers.
